content.text:
I wrote `Label: incorrect` to `/work/answer.txt`.

The file has no label column, so I had to judge each literal interpretation myself. User 37244 has 10 instances. I judged 3 correct and 7 incorrect:

- **Correct:** "leak out" → "disclosed", "lost in her thoughts" → "unsociable and aggressive temper" is not in this group, so the three are "leak out" → "disclosed", "sour temper" → "unsociable and aggressive temper", and "heavenly ride" → "a ride you can really enjoy".
- **Incorrect:** the other seven, including "a golden sun" → "a black sun" and "The faculty meeting was a tragedy" → "highly aggressive".

Some of the incorrect calls are less clear-cut, such as the "steamed up" and "tragedy" lines. Even if two or three of them flipped to correct, the count would still be close to even, so the answer depends on my reading of those lines.
